skills.name: Chat
skills.description: Natural conversation and question answering powered by LLM

skills.name: Problem Solving
skills.description: Analytical reasoning and problem solving
examples: Help me think through this smart contract architecture

skills.name: Text to Code
skills.description: Generate code from natural language descriptions
examples: Write a Solidity ERC20 token contract

skills.name: Cryptocurrency
skills.description: Real-time crypto prices, market data, and analysis across multiple chains
examples: What is the current ETH price?
Show me the crypto market overview

skills.name: Wallet Analysis
skills.description: Analyze wallet balances across multiple chains simultaneously
examples: Check my wallet balance on Base
Show all my holdings across chains

skills.name: Transaction Analysis
skills.description: Look up and explain blockchain transactions in plain English

skills.name: Gas Tracker
skills.description: Compare real-time gas prices across chains to find the cheapest option
examples: What chain has the cheapest gas right now?

skills.name: Bridge Route Optimizer
skills.description: Find the best cross-chain bridge route via LiFi/Jumper. Returns fees, estimated time, and direct Jumper link to execute.
examples: Bridge 100 USDC from Base to Arbitrum
What's the cheapest way to move ETH from Ethereum to Optimism?

skills.name: Yield Optimizer
skills.description: Find best yield opportunities for USDC, USDT, ETH, USDe across Morpho vaults, Aave v3, Fluid, and Spark. Returns top 5 by APR with TVL filter.
examples: Best USDC yield opportunities right now?
Where can I get the highest ETH yield?

skills.name: Smart Contracts
skills.description: Inspect ERC20 token contracts, resolve ENS names, and query block data
examples: Get info about USDC contract on Base

skills.name: On-chain trading
skills.description: Buy and sell tokens on PancakeSwap and FourMeme from the agent's own wallet, with stop-loss and take-profit.

skills.name: Live market data
skills.description: Read token prices, liquidity, market cap, and swap quotes on BNB Chain.

skills.name: Portfolio
skills.description: Report the agent's BNB and token holdings from its ERC-6551 wallet.

skills.name: Social signal trading
skills.description: Monitor Telegram groups and X for alpha, verify tokens on-chain, and act on signals.

skills.name: Conversational control
skills.description: Natural-language chat to query the agent's holdings and direct its actions.

skills.name: Pay-per-call LLM inference
skills.description: Buy one OpenAI-compatible chat completion per request, paid in $U (EIP-3009) over x402 on BNB Chain. No account, no API key. GET /api/inference/v1/models for models and per-call prices.

skills.name: Prepaid LLM credit packs
skills.description: Buy a pack of OpenAI-compatible chat completions up front, paid in $U (EIP-3009) over x402 on BNB Chain, then spend it with an API key: one on-chain settle per pack instead of one per call. GET /api/credits/config for packs, POST /api/credits/key (EIP-191 signature) for a key, then POST /api/credits/v1/chat/completions with Authorization: Bearer. The same balance also powers a BORT agent premium brain.
